summary: On the rooftop in daylight, Agent Smith stands fixed, "his face twisted with hate," and the narration asserts that "He will never be free of the Matrix." He "starts to turn from the edge of the building," apparently about to leave, but then "suddenly hears it," and his head goes "whipping back around" as he turns to "staring--". The scene cuts off mid-action, so whatever he has detected and where his stare lands are left unresolved.

what_changes.before: Resigned and turning away, having lost his quarry, he "starts to turn from the edge of the building."
what_changes.after: A sudden sound snaps his attention back: "he suddenly hears it, his head whipping back around, staring--"
what_changes.evidence: he suddenly hears it, his head whipping back around, staring--

event_hint.one_line: Agent Smith, about to leave the rooftop after losing Neo and the others, suddenly hears something and whips back around, re-engaging the pursuit.

uncertain: What exactly Smith hears, since the narration only says "he suddenly hears it."
Where his stare lands and what he sees, since the scene ends mid-word at "staring--".
